name: Bend with the Wind
body:
General | Combat Stamina

Bend with the Wind (Meditation)
Source Faiths and Philosophies pg. 19
Meditation allows you to regulate your body temperature, heart rate, and other attributes to resist the elements.

Prerequisites: Wis 15, Body Control, Endurance, Meditation Master.

Benefit: For 24 hours after you meditate, you gain cold resistance 5 and fire resistance 5.
